notes.title: CHRISTMAS UPDATE!
notes.content:
Merry Christmas, guys!
How are your holidays going?

This time, we added new stuff to Little Briar Rose! :D
Together with it, we offer a [b]30% discount on both the Game and the OST+Artwork bundle[/b]! ✨

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

☆ [b]4 new original tracks[/b] have been added to Little Briar Rose! If you've purchased the OST+Artwork bundle, you'll now receive those new songs as well :)

☆ Improved Controller support: switching between controller and mouse controls is now super smooth and battle-tested!

[h2]BUGS[/h2]

☆ Unity update to 2017.4.35f1, featuring lots of bug fixes and macOS Catalina support

☆ Fixed a long-running bug on some Linux distros, causing the characters to walk in random directions

☆ Fixed a small bug when trying to walk while a character is starting to talk

☆ Fixed a couple of broken links within the game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27005500/d8714dbc5c2ec9d25ab80f8bb9b1c7c0a442c071.png[/img]

That's all for this update!
Enjoy your Holidays and see you the next time!

notes.title: HALLOWEEN SALES + FRENCH & BELARUSSIAN LOCALIZATION
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/5fbea81764aa56c226bcee6300d20747fdb6e597.png[/img]

Hey guys,
Happy Halloween to everyone! :D

This year's Halloween we have a juicy discount and an update on the game.
We worked on integrating a couple of new languages, French and Belarusian. Hooray!

This was possible thanks to the help of you guys out there!

[h1]Credits for French language[/h1]
Nonpareil
maddingue
ghosthermione
Skywilly

[h1]Credits for Belarussian language[/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/lexby]lex.by[/url]

[i]A special thanks go to Skywilly for curing the official French review.[/i]

[h1]Beta Languages[/h1]
You can now access these languages in game, selecting them from the options menu. These will be in beta for a while.

[b]If you find any issue, please report it using the steam forum or contacting us at our discord channel: https://discordapp.com/invite/elfgames[/b]

If you want you can contribute yourself!
We've added the possibility to translate the store page as well
http://translate.elfgamesworks.com/collaboration/


[h1]On a final thought[/h1]
This translation project has been a success, so far.
We weren't really sure if anyone had in mind to help us translating the game. This was a sort of experiment without much of a hope.
Little Briar Rose is a quite verbose game, hence the obstacle was steep, but you guys surprised us!

We hope to receive your feedback and, eventually, your issues reports.
We are ready to fix them! :D

That's all for today.
Have a nice Halloween!

notes.title: New Package & Spanish Localization!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/cc7d965b41aafdcc74fb1aafcc2a08d6898fd89f.png[/img]

Hi everyone,
how 's it going? Big news today!


[h1]New Package on Sale![/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/b4f75e378065e39272bc204292562ce313982407.png[/img]

What could this DLC be? In short: our Art efforts!
[b]LBR Original Sountrack & LBR Artbook.[/b]

Only a few know that Little Briar Rose traveled around the country expos followed by an original artbook drawn by our artist. The time of expos is now over, and we want to open the chance to get the artbook to the players.
[h1]You'll find 50 pages of concepts, stories and in-depth info about the characters, the lore, and our personal experience.[/h1]

Moreover, you'll find all the [b]original music[/b] composed by our friends Humble Student and Francesco Percassi, who believed in this project as much as we did!
We still owe them big time for this. :)
We hope you'll like it!


[h1]Spanish Language - Beta[/h1]
We are happy to inform you that our first community-translated language is out on [b]beta now![/b]
The Spanish language has been added to the game thanks to the help of:
- [i][b]Alexandra Letelier González (Sacred)[/b][/i]
- [i][b]Luis M. Robayo (Luincho)[/b][/i]
They translated an insane amount of lines: we are speechless!

You can access the new language through the language option, choosing the beta Spanish translation. We already tested the game, but if any issue were to occur, don't hesitate to reach us on Steam or, even better, on our [b]Discord Channel[/b]:

https://discordapp.com/invite/elfgames


[h1]We Want More Languages[/h1]
Do you want to help with new language translations? Do you want to jump in and bring your language into the game?
You can! 
[b]You'll find all the info in this topic:[/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/555290/discussions/0/1726450077643465554/


[h1]Special Sales[/h1]
Finally, to promote the DLC and the new language, Little Briar Rose will be on sale [i]for a week.[/i]
[b]Get your chance now![/b]


That's all for now.
Have a nice summer, princes!

notes.title: #LOVEINDIES WEEK UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/1438d8aa88ac8ec513e23691078759252216b984.png[/img]

Hi there!

Little Briar Rose's team is joining the [url=https://twitter.com/search?src=typd&q=%23loveindies] #loveindies Week[/url] and we hope you're hyped to join too.
We are preparing some cool news about [b]Little Briar Rose[/b], which we'll reveal during this week, so stay tuned!

The [url=https://twitter.com/search?src=typd&q=%23loveindies] #loveindies Week[/url] aims to celebrate the indie community in its entirety.
This celebration wishes to shorten the distance between players and devs, encouraging you to express yourself and leave a review.

You might not know how much a simple review or rating can mean to an indie development team. They make a huge difference to us! We can learn and grow this way.
So, if you get the chance, please leave a review about Little Briar Rose!

Thank you for supporting indie games, we wouldn’t be able to do what we love without you!


[h1]First announcement:[/h1]
As a gift to the indie community and to help the game to spread around, we've decided to definitively change the price from 7.99$ to 4.99$. Little Briar Rose was our first project and we would love to see it played more and more!


[h1]Update on Localisation project[/h1]
Here's the progress about the community localisation project!
We can't contain our excitement! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/cb56a794bd13d7371729889491a0f9545d70e610.jpg[/img]

Looks like Spanish is almost done! This is incredible guys, I'd like to give a big thank to all the translators <3



We'll see soon with another news!
Thank you very much for your support!

notes.title: SUMMER UPDATE + CALL FOR TRANSLATORS
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/618b013c5abfaa0c3022e2d71f77e6b175c63cc8.png[/img]

Hi everyone,
What's up? Are you all enjoying the summer so far?

The team is glad to offer you a special 50% for the Steam Summer Sales.

The sales come with a couple of updates:

[h1]Call for Translators[/h1]
Little Briar Rose is a text-rich game. Quite text-rich actually! Maybe not the most text-rich game around, but we had quite some fun coming up with cool dialogues and funny jokes, painting a very unique dialogues style.
This, however, cut our legs short when we dreamed to open the game to more than English and Italian (our mother tongue).

Still, some of you reached out to us asking if they could translate the game for fun, so we've told ourselves: why don't we continue living the dream a bit before waking up?

Taking into consideration all this, we've worked on adapting the game: Little Briar Rose is now open to be translated from the community!

[b]But what should you do in practice?[/b]
Go to this link: http://translate.elfgamesworks.com/collaboration/project?id=300139
Select which language you want to translate it to (If your language is not listed, please report to us)
Create an account for free to start translating!

We have to warn you, though, princes: Our lovey-dovey game counts around 17k words. How cute, right?

As proof of your unyielding valor, any brave soul that will collaborate to this challenge will be automatically added to the game credits.
Thank you!


[h1]Discord Official Channel[/h1]

We remind you of our official discord channel, where you can reach us for the purpose just above, or for anything else related to the game.
https://discordapp.com/invite/elfgames

Come and have fun! ^ ^

[h1]Today's Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Update to Unity 2017.3.1
[*] Preparing the game for multiple localizations
[*] Fix wrong achievement description
[*] Simplified main menu, removing useless elements
[*] Now you can open/close the menu with Esc
[*] Replaced a few sound effects with softer ones
[*] Fix attempt for Linux users (We'd like to receive feedback on this)
[/list]

Hello everyone,
Today we come with a lot of news!

[h1]50% sales[/h1]
First of all, Little Briar Rose is 50% off for a week <3
Don't miss the discount!

notes.title: Update and Backstage
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/618b013c5abfaa0c3022e2d71f77e6b175c63cc8.png[/img]

Hello everyone,
It’s been a while!
Did you miss us? We hope so!
We are still working hard to improve the game from your feedbacks, but there were also a lot of interesting news for our team.

However, let’s start from the beginning! Here is a list of changes we introduced in this release:


[h1]Changelist[/h1]
[list]
[*] The intro will now restart after idling for more than 30 seconds in the Title 

[*] Minor audio bug-fix while building the house

[*] Fixed the camera that occasionally froze in the Castle Map

[*] Fixed a bug where the Princess' room song wasn't starting after loading a save

[*] Unity upgrade to 5.5.2

[*] Fixed a few English typos

[*] Fixed a bug with a fairy sprite that wasn't showing properly on game load

[*] Gameplay improvement of gnome costume scene: It's now possible to change items before going to the Merman. As some users pointed out, that missing choice was pedantic and unnecessary.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/a5e319b6fd301c9202d4a3044960e4446a7fcd47.png[/img]
[/list]


[h1]Mayor Known Issue: Fishing[/h1]
The Fishing Game has officially won the "most-hated" minigame award in Little Briar Rose.
We received many negative feedbacks about that part, so we are working to rebuild it entirely, introducing some new and enjoying mechanics to improve flawed design choices.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/6371bdad733483b03d57ad0b8fd5c3fdf4683690.png[/img]


[h1]Little Briar Rose making-of[/h1]
Our artist started a short blog-post series that explains how she achieved the stained-glass art style of Little Briar Rose.
You can find the first part here:

http://www.elfgamesworks.com/short?to=howto-stained-glass-game-inspirations


[h1]Best Game Design Award for Little Briar Rose[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/ade1628b3fb8e6d5aaad800f8758e7977a93337e.jpg[/img]
This month has been an exciting and important month for us. Our game has been nominated in all four categories of Premio Drago d’Oro, an Italian video games award.
We were, and are, astonished by this local, yet significative news. Finally, last week the final event took place and our game won the Best Game Design Award.

We are happy and willing to challenge the bigger world, with this and new projects we are developing, since this is the beginning of a journey we will take.
We would say thanks to all our players that helped us with constructive feedback and support.
Thanks!


The news is now over. Thanks for reading this slightly different news!

Don't forget to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/BriarRoseGame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/LittleBriarRoseGame/]Facebook[/url] for some small preview that will be released in the next days!

See you in the next update!

We received many negative feedbacks about that part, so we are working to rebuild it entirely, introducing some new and enjoying mechanics to improve flawed design choices.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/6371bdad733483b03d57ad0b8fd5c3fdf4683690.png[/img]


[h1]Little Briar Rose making-of[/h1]
Our artist started a short blog-post series that explains how she achieved the stained-glass art style of Little Briar Rose.
You can find the first part here:

http://www.elfgamesworks.com/short?to=howto-stained-glass-game-inspirations


[h1]Best Game Design Award for Little Briar Rose[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/ade1628b3fb8e6d5aaad800f8758e7977a93337e.jpg[/img]
This month has been an exciting and important month for us. Our game has been nominated in all four categories of Premio Drago d’Oro, an Italian video games award.
We were, and are, astonished by this local, yet significative news. Finally, last week the final event took place and our game won the Best Game Design Award.

We are happy and willing to challenge the bigger world, with this and new projects we are developing, since this is the beginning of a journey we will take.
We would say thanks to all our players that helped us with constructive feedback and support.
Thanks!


The news is now over. Thanks for reading this slightly different news!

Don't forget to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/BriarRoseGame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/LittleBriarRoseGame/]Facebook[/url] for some small preview that will be released in the next days!

See you in the next update!

notes.title: Improved Save System
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/7d335dd92e44309928de3c9fa6cd7f31c09815b1.png[/img]

Hello there!
In today's update we'll talk about the save system.


We noticed, thanks to your feedback, that the actual save system gives a bit of confusion. This happens because players always spawn in the first map when the game loads, and it might seem that some progress is lost.
To whoever had this doubt, we assure that all data is just fine.
Nonetheless, we decided to change the fairy save system and develop something less confusing.


[h1]No More Fairy Save System[/h1]
The new save system will get note of the map you're in, so no more backtracking to the first screen. There is also no need to talk to the first fairy to save. The game will automatically save after every action and when you exit the game.
If your pc should shut down or the game crashes for whatever reason, your saves will be fine.


[h1]Steam Cloud Is On[/h1]
As we focused on the "improve save system" task, we also finished to add the Steam Cloud saves. We've had this done for a while, but we waited for more testing. Everything works fine, so it is now out of beta.


[h1]Mighty Princess Patch[/h1]
Princesses graphics have been fully integrated into Mighty Princess MOD. The main feature of the game, the "perma-death", will now have a princess version, along with other minor graphics fixes.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/2e0ffda94457973d1b574895904379d23fe55071.gif[/img]



Lastly, some bug fix list:
 - Game updated to Unity3D 5.5.1
 - Fix workshop page to show all popular mods
 - Fix Goblin minigame tutorial
 - Other fix to Mighty Princess MOD


That's all for today.
Don't forget to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/BriarRoseGame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/LittleBriarRoseGame/]Facebook[/url] for some small preview that will be released in the next days!

See you on the next update!

notes.title: Workshop beta: betatesters needed!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/9dcb3d1014be8d24ce72aecb68ab5a32b02b2f8d.png[/img]

Hello, princes and princesses!
Today we are happy to announce that [b]Little Briar Rose[/b] has a [b]Steam Workshop[/b]!
Maybe some of you would be surprised about implementing the Steam Workshop in an Adventure Game like Little Briar Rose.
However, we are pretty sure that this "experiment" can create new and interesting game experiences for all players.

This is a change we worked hard for, in order to give more freedom. The Steam Workshop lets us add many ideas to the game without changing its roots, giving the players total freedom to follow us in this experience.

[h1]What's Steam Workshop[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/2003cbbca76223a5299f5df989653585b4e08d70.png[/img]

For those who don't know what Steam Workshop is: [i]It's a platform where players can install and enable extra modifications for the game. These mods can vary minor or major aspects of the game.[/i]
[b]These mods are not replacement for game updates, that will be regurarly maintained.[/b]

In the first stage, mods will be developed exclusively by us.


[h1]Join the Beta[/h1]

[U][b]Now... the workshop is in beta and we need betatesters!
If you want to join our betatester steam group, write yourself in this topic:[/b][/u]

http://steamcommunity.com/app/555290/discussions/0/152392786902861618/

The beta version will also unlock these features:
[list]
 [*] Steam Workshop
 [*] Steam OS / Linux Support
 [*] First mod available. In tone with these days: Christmas mod!
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/707fb355dddca21d423b9bb40216b7d7204dcc6b.png[/img]

Thanks in advance to everybody!

Follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/LittleBriarRoseGame/]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/BriarRoseGame]Twitter[/url] to always know what we are working on!

Happy holidays!
